{{Short description|Discontinuous change of a quantity in algebraic geometry or string theory}}
{{string theory}}

In [[algebraic geometry]] and [[string theory]], the phenomenon of '''wall-crossing''' describes the discontinuous change of a certain quantity, such as an integer [[geometric invariant]], an [[winding number|index]] or a space of [[BPS state]], across a [[codimension]]-one wall in a space of [[stable point|stability conditions]], a so-called [[wall of marginal stability]].
